gates.title: How page freshness
criteria: How page renders GET /v1/freshness sources and roster dates.
evidence_required: Receipt with API /v1/freshness pass and Playwright /how source link visible.

gates.title: Deterministic web and API suite
criteria: Lint, graders, API tests, and Playwright smoke pass on one unchanged git HEAD.
evidence_required: Receipt under .session/testing/receipts/ naming the git HEAD.

gates.title: Live visual vs DESIGN.md
criteria: Current screenshots match DESIGN.md tokens and disclosure on How, map, and report.
procedure: Capture live /how, /map, and report modal; compare to .session/docs/DESIGN.md.
evidence_required: Current-hash screenshot packet with pass/fail against DESIGN.md.

gates.title: Blind UX journey
criteria: A blind actor can report an issue and read freshness without implementation notes.
procedure: Give a fresh reviewer only the running app and the report mission.
evidence_required: Blind journey notes on the same frozen hash.

gates.title: Accessibility and trust runtime
criteria: Names, contrast, targets, and no author_user_id leak on public surfaces.
procedure: Runtime a11y pass plus public API author-field check on the frozen hash.
evidence_required: A11y runtime receipt and API leak check on the same HEAD.

gates.title: iOS XCUITest on Simulator
criteria: HisabPuneUITests pass on iPhone Simulator against the same product API.
evidence_required: xcodebuild log on the frozen hash.

gates.title: Empty frozen re-review
criteria: A subsequent full review on the same hash finds no new P0/P1.
procedure: Rerun required dimensions without source changes; record empty_iteration.
evidence_required: Receipt with empty_iteration true on the same git HEAD.
